title: onboard-epimetheus-20b-v1.0-perf-metadata-changelog-automation
author: Maya Kapoor
description: Summary: Onboard Epimetheus-20B v1.0 into the model registry with metadata, validated performance profiles, and automated changelog/release-note generation. Motivation: Epimetheus-20B is a high-throughput dense transformer variant we've validated for low-latency customer workloads. Onboarding this model unlocks a new performant option for customers who require 4k+ context throughput at competitive cost. This PR bundles three related pieces: 1) model metadata and packaging for the registry (checksum, config, supported quantizations), 2) perf profile artifacts (latency/throughput matrices across instance types + recommended runtime knobs), and 3) automation to append an entry to the automated changelog generator so release notes are created from onboarding metadata. What I changed: - Added model manifest and metadata files under models/epimetheus/20b/v1.0 (model card, config, sha256, supported precisions). - Added perf profiles under models/epimetheus/20b/v1.0/perf-profiles/*.json with summarized measurements and recommended runtime config (batch sizes, kv-cache hints, compiler flags). - Updated registry index and onboarding script to include Epimetheus entry. - Extended changelog automation: the changelog generator now picks up the model manifest's "changelog_hint" field and creates a templated release note; added tests and a small migration to backfill changelog for recent onboards. - Docs: short entry in docs/models.md describing Epimetheus guidance. Tests and validation: - Unit tests for manifest schema and changelog template generation added. - Integration perf-run artifacts attached and validated in CI (smoke latency/throughput check on representative instance). - Manual spot checks: sampled generations across 512/2048/4096 tokens to ensure KV-caching consistency. Rollout plan: - Model is registered but flagged as experimental until datasets/QA completes; runtime team will enable general availability after a coordinated rollout. - No changes to serving runtime code paths required; this is registry and automation only. Notes on compatibility: - Provided fallback aliases so requests using older names map to the canonical model_id. - Quantization profiles included (int8 and fp16) but int8 marked experimental. Security and compliance: - No customer data included. Model artifacts are references to external storage with verified checksums. - KMS metadata included for private deployments. See linked Linear task ENG-4821 for compliance checklist. Changelog entry (automated): The automation will produce a templated note that includes model summary, perf highlights, recommended runtimes, and migration notes. If the PR is merged, the release notes generator will include Epimetheus-20B v1.0 in the next release draft.
